landing.meta.description: A focused guitar lesson on swing feel, downstroke attack, octave shapes, and the essential gear behind an iconic riff.

landing.notes.title: Technical notes
landing.notes.lead: Mastering the swing feel is non-negotiable. This isn't about speed; it's about the space between the notes.
landing.notes.body: Focus on the downstroke attack. The aggression comes from the wrist, snapping down on the low E and A strings. Mute the A string with the pad of your index finger when playing the octave shapes.

rulesPage.meta.title: Room Rules — Slash Editorial
rulesPage.meta.description: Essential rehearsal room rules for keeping the space safe, clean and ready to play.
rulesPage.hero.description: Respect the space. Respect the sound.
rulesPage.important.heading: Before you play.
rulesPage.important.items.use_sanitiser: Please use hand sanitiser before rehearsing.
rulesPage.important.items.bring_change_o: In bad weather, please bring a change of shoes — especially drummers.
rulesPage.sections.label: Rehearsal room rules
rulesPage.sections.general.label: Room care
rulesPage.sections.general.heading: General
rulesPage.sections.general.items.care_fo: Treat the room and the equipment with care.
rulesPage.sections.general.items.leave_a: Leave the room in the same condition in which you found it.
rulesPage.sections.general.items.no_misu: It is forbidden to use the equipment for any purpose other than intended.
rulesPage.sections.general.items.damage_: The person responsible is liable for intentional damage.
rulesPage.sections.drums.label: Instruments
rulesPage.sections.drums.heading: Drums
rulesPage.sections.drums.items.no_excess: Do not hit drums and cymbals with excessive force.
rulesPage.sections.drums.items.stool_onl: Do not sit on the drum stool when you are not playing.
rulesPage.sections.drums.items.return_ev: After rehearsing, make sure that every part of the drum kit is back in its place.
rulesPage.sections.drums.items.keep_item: Do not place drinks or other objects on the instruments or near the electronics.
rulesPage.sections.guitars.label: Instruments
rulesPage.sections.guitars.heading: Guitars & amplifiers
rulesPage.sections.guitars.items.return_: Return all three guitars to their stands after use.
rulesPage.sections.guitars.items.do_not_: Do not lay guitars on the floor, on amplifiers or on other surfaces.
rulesPage.sections.guitars.items.mute_be: Before plugging or unplugging cables, make sure the devices are switched off or turned down.
rulesPage.sections.guitars.items.no_max_: Do not turn amplifiers up to maximum volume without consulting everyone present.
rulesPage.sections.guitars.items.keep_ca: Cables must not be placed where people can step on them.
rulesPage.sections.technology.label: Equipment
rulesPage.sections.technology.heading: Electronics & tech
rulesPage.sections.technology.items.chec: Before switching anything on, check that all cables are connected correctly.
rulesPage.sections.technology.items.no_d: Do not use damaged cables, power supplies or connectors.
rulesPage.sections.technology.items.neve: Never pull devices by the cable.
rulesPage.sections.technology.items.swit: After rehearsing, switch off amplifiers, speakers, the mixing desk and all other devices.
rulesPage.sections.technology.items.repo: If something malfunctions, do not try to repair the equipment yourself. Inform the person responsible at: [PHONE NUMBER TO BE ADDED].
rulesPage.sections.microphones.label: Equipment
rulesPage.sections.microphones.heading: Microphones & more
rulesPage.sections.microphones.items.do_: Do not throw or drop microphones.
rulesPage.sections.microphones.items.sta: Set up stands securely and do not overload them.
rulesPage.sections.microphones.items.ret: Return microphones and stands to their places after use.
rulesPage.sections.microphones.items.do_: Do not adjust devices unless necessary.
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.label: Room care
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.heading: Food & drink
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.items.keep: Keep drinks away from drums, amplifiers, the mixing desk and other electronics.
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.items.no_d: Do not place cups or bottles on the equipment.
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.items.no_l: Do not leave any rubbish behind.
rulesPage.sections.food_drink.items.clea: If something is spilled, report it and clean it up immediately.
rulesPage.sections.volume.label: Respect
rulesPage.sections.volume.heading: Volume
rulesPage.sections.volume.items.no_dange: Do not turn the system up to dangerously high volume.
rulesPage.sections.volume.items.respect_: Be considerate of neighbours and other people in the building.
rulesPage.sections.volume.items.listen_t: If someone asks you to turn it down, do not ignore the request.
rulesPage.after_rehearsal.heading: Before you leave.
rulesPage.after_rehearsal.items.coil_cab: Coil cables and put them away neatly.
rulesPage.after_rehearsal.items.return_m: Return microphones and stands to their places.
rulesPage.final_rule.heading: The rehearsal room is no place for carelessness.
rulesPage.final_rule.lead: Keep the room ready for the next person.
rulesPage.final_rule.actions.clean_mess: Something made dirty? — Clean it up.
rulesPage.final_rule.actions.restore_set: Something adjusted? — Restore it to its original state.
rulesPage.final_rule.support: Take care of the equipment — everyone wants to use it!
